components.name: Battery Modules
components.reasoning: Battery modules are discrete units that house individual lithium-ion cells connected in series or parallel arrays. These are commonly procured as complete assemblies from battery manufacturers.

components.name: Battery Pack Frame
components.reasoning: The frame provides structural integrity and serves as an environmental barrier, supporting the battery cells and managing space constraints within the vehicle chassis.

components.name: Thermal Management System (coolant lines, heat exchangers)
components.reasoning: The thermal system is critical for controlling cell temperature to prevent overheating or degradation of performance, typically purchased as a complete subassembly with its own supply chain.

components.name: Safety Diodes and Fuses
components.reasoning: These components are crucial for safety by protecting the battery from short circuits and overcurrent conditions, often integrated within the cooling system but considered distinct components in design iterations.

components.name: CAN Bus Connectors (communication modules)
components.reasoning: CAN bus connectors allow communication between different battery cells and vehicle electronics, enabling real-time monitoring of health status, a separate subassembly ensuring data reliability during operation.

components.name: Power Electronics (inverters and controllers)
components.reasoning: Components like inverters convert DC from the battery to AC for motor drive, typically manufactured as independent units due to their specialized circuits and control systems.

components.name: Mechanical Mounts and Brackets
components.reasoning: These mount the battery pack to the vehicle structure, ensuring secure positioning and alignment but are separate components with distinct supply chains.

components.name: Enclosure (heat sinks)
components.reasoning: Enclosures provide protection against environmental factors while also facilitating heat dissipation through their design, often separately produced by specialized manufacturers.

components.name: Battery Pack
components.reasoning: The battery pack is a distinct, critical assembly of cells managed by the battery management system, necessary for power storage in EVs.

components.name: Thermal Management System (TMS) Assembly
components.reasoning: This assembly includes cooling pipes and channels designed to maintain optimal battery temperatures, separate from the battery pack itself as a distinct manufacturing unit.

components.name: Battery Management System (BMS)
components.reasoning: The BMS controls individual cell voltages, currents, and ensures safety in the battery pack, operating independently but interfacing with the cells and TMS for optimal performance.

components.name: Enclosure (Chassis)
components.reasoning: The mechanical structure protecting the internal components, separate from other assemblies such as the TMS or BMS, ensuring proper installation and protection against environmental factors.

components.name: Power Electronics Module (PEM)
components.reasoning: This module converts DC power from the battery to AC for propulsion use, critical but often an integrated subassembly separate from other system components.

components.name: CAN Bus Interface Board
components.reasoning: For communication between various vehicle systems, including sensors and actuators; essential for overall vehicle control yet a separate manufactured component.

components.name: Connection Terminals (Battery Terminal Connectors)
components.reasoning: These connectors ensure reliable electrical connection with the vehicle's power train, typically distinct components within the battery pack design despite being integral to its safety and functionality.

components.name: Protective Film/Liners
components.reasoning: Used between cells or around them for insulation and protection from physical damage or chemical leakage; while critical, they often integrate with cell assemblies but are considered distinct components in supply chain terms.

components.name: Pressure Relief Valves (PRVs)
components.reasoning: Ensuring safety during internal pressures build-up, these valves provide a separate component due to their critical nature for battery pack safety measures.
